business_problem: With the increasing complexity of financial products and a more demanding client base in the modern era, the organization was facing a challenge. Manually analyzing each client’s transaction history to decipher their current requirements, life circumstances and preferences became untenable.
solution_summary: To streamline customer service and boost customer engagement, Česká Spořitelna, part of Erste Group, recognizes the importance of empowering branch advisors with personalized conversation starters that cater to individual client needs and interests. As a leading financial institution with roots going back to 1819, the bank has continually emphasized the centrality of the client-advisor relationship. With the increasing complexity of financial products and a more demanding client base in the modern era, the organization was facing a challenge. Access to data was scattered among multiple teams using different tools (Oracle DB, Cloudera, Kafka), with no efficient way to leverage all data sources simultaneously. Manually analyzing each client’s transaction history to decipher their current requirements, life circumstances and preferences became untenable.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Jobs
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and production jobs.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

data_flow: Customer, product, and engagement data lands in Databricks, is transformed in the lakehouse under Unity Catalog governance, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services.
